Mathematics
(journal)
Mathematics
is a semi-monthly
peer-reviewed
open-access
scientific journal
that covers all aspects of
pure mathematics
and
applied mathematics
. It publishes theoretical and experimental research articles, short communications, and reviews. It was established in 2013 and is published by
MDPI
. The
editor-in-chief
is Francisco Chiclana (
De Montfort University
).
